title: terraform: modularize private deployment state layout; add gpu_node_pool + iam + networking modules
author: Ava Chen
description: Modularize the Terraform layout used by Private deployments to improve upgrade/rollback safety and enable targeted state operations. This PR introduces three new modules (gpu_node_pool, iam, networking), a revised state layout that scopes statefiles/workspaces per module-environment, migration helpers to move existing state into the new layout, and CI/plan-time validation. Motivation: customers running Private with GPU node pools (on-prem/cloud) require predictable upgrades and isolated state so DR/restore and partial rollbacks are possible without touching unrelated resources. The gpu_node_pool module supports GPU types, node taints, autoscaling policies, and kubelet config overrides; iam provides least-privilege roles and service-account mappings used by the private installer; networking centralizes VPC/subnet allocation, peering, and shared-services subnets. The change includes unit plan tests, a terraform fmt/tflint pass, and a documented migration path with backup steps. Related: ENG-4231 for state-layout design and INF-1187 for autoscaler behavior tests.
commits: refactor(state): split top-level state into per-module workspaces and add state migration scripts

feat(networking): add VPC/subnet/peering module and shared-services config
test(ci): add plan unit tests for modules + small e2e plan validation harness
chore(docs): add migration guide, examples/private-deploy/state-layout.md and README updates

ci_details: integration-plan-check: pass (minimal smoke plans against emulated backend)
merge_details: Squash-and-merged by Ben Patel. Merge includes ENG-4231 reference in the commit message. Merge strategy chosen to keep main history linear and group the state-migration commits. No post-merge hotfix required.
release_notes: - Introduce modular Terraform layout for Private deployments (gpu_node_pool, iam, networking); - Add state migration scripts and documented migration path; - gpu_node_pool: supports autoscaling, GPU types and node taints; - IAM module: least-privilege roles for private installer; - Networking: VPC/subnet/peering module; - Adds plan/unit tests and CI validation for private modules
notes_for_ops: Before applying in customer environments run scripts/terraform-state-migrate/migrate_state.sh with snapshots enabled and follow examples/private-deploy/state-layout.md. Ensure a single operator holds the state lock during migration. For Dedicated customers contact Platform SRE to coordinate downtime windows.
rollback_instructions: Re-run migration script using the backup snapshot and restore previous top-level statefiles. Modules are additive; rollback involves restoring pre-migration statefiles to the original workspace and re-applying. See examples/private-deploy/state-layout.md for step-by-step instructions.
